subject: phoenix
pitch:
Category: Fantastical creature.
Subject: phoenix with flame plumage, wings spread.
Style: Genshin Impact.
reasoning:
I'm planning a compact but detailed phoenix module with a skeleton, spread wings, flame-feather cards, toon cel shading, and glow effects, aiming for a moderate-length build around 300 lines with a flight-ready pose standing on a perch.

I'm laying out the skeleton: hip, spine, neck, and head joints positioned with catmull curves, then planning the body as a loft swept along the spine path with varying radius for the torso shape.

For the head, I'm adding a sphere skull with cone beak parts and a jaw joint, plus eye decals mapped onto the surface. For the tail, I'm planning five long streamer feathers as separate swept paths curving from the rump outward with tapering radius and gradient coloring.

Now I'm setting up the wing armature with a shoulder-elbow-wrist chain positioned symmetrically on each side, naming joints by side for left and right.

I'm building the primary feathers as flame-shaped leaf outlines extruded along the wrist, orienting each feather's width along x and sweeping its length along the feather direction vector.

Secondaries attach near the elbow fanning back-and-out, primaries fan from the wrist, and I'm coloring each feather with a root-to-tip gradient from red to yellow/orange using a shared paint function keyed to feather length, with coverts shorter and redder and the back row longer and gold. I'll use roughly 8 primaries, 7 secondaries, and 6 coverts per wing.

Totaling that out gives 42 wing feather parts plus 7 tail streamers. For the head I'm adding a flame-blade crest, skipping the neck ruff, and giving the chest a glowing orb decal. For the legs I'm building a hip-to-foot limb chain with bends at the knee and ankle, tapered sweep radii, and three forward toe spikes plus one back toe in dark gold at the ankle joint.

Now I'm checking ground contact so the toes sit just above y=0 and confirming the leg lengths are enough to reach the bent stance. I'm scattering small flame-textured cards across the body's upper surface for an aura effect, with glow enabled, and planning a gradient paint scheme along the body transitioning from red toward another color for a countershaded look.

For the head, I'm placing eye decals as small scaled spheres mirrored on both sides, and shaping the beak as a cone aimed forward from the head position.

Now I'm working out the upper and lower beak as spike shapes attached to the head and jaw bones with slightly different lengths, radii, and downward angles, then positioning the head and neck joints in local coordinates before moving on to sweep the body shape along a curved path.

Defining the spine and neck chains with catmull-rom control points, planning to concatenate the paths and vary the radius along the sweep for a tapering body shape.

Now I'm adding the hips as a root joint, branching off a tail chain that extends backward with two more points, and sketching out legs parented to the hips and wing chains attached to the chest joint for a three-segment wing structure.

Working out feather placement...

Writing toe and limb logic...
